omissions.description: Nonblocking source-acquisition task retained in dependency_in_vivo_reference5: acquire/register PMID 23178934 (PMC3706714), DOI 10.1038/nchembio.1131, including applicable Methods/supplements, and inspect the adopted cellular-modification details and relation to NAI-N3 dosing. The primary article reports the cellular-input, treatment, extraction and library interfaces; the absent dependency does not establish an unknown route or authorize importing its older reagent conditions.

Nonblocking supplement-acquisition task retained in separate_supplement_packet_coverage: acquire/register the original NIHMS658901-supplement-1.docx and protocol-relevant Fig. 1/Extended Data Figs. 1–4 renditions linked by the registered XML, then inspect applicability. Only article passages and captions are registered here. The named Supplementary Tables 1/2 are reported as downstream VTD motif resources; do not assume they exhaust the DOCX or make unseen contents mandatory. No consequential production interface has been shown missing from the reported Methods.

Nonblocking analysis-evidence task retained in barcode_coordinate_association, analysis_dependencies_and_settings and validity_RT_stop_variable: acquire/register publication-relevant archived qczhang/icSHAPE code and read-layout/protocol documentation to establish barcode coordinates, exact tool options/multihit allocation, numerical edge cases and the library/stage association of validity RT-stop coverage. The candidate faithfully preserves these as unknown while describing the published rule; historical numerical reproduction is not claimed.

Nonblocking internal-recipe task retained in probing_dose_and_input_amount, vitro_context_recipe_specificity, named_wash_buffer_transfer, manufacturer_delegated_cleanup and library_amplification_recipe: retrieve applicable original protocol/supplement and contemporaneous manufacturer instructions for working dose/RNA input, in vitro duration/buffer ratio, library wash-buffer formulation assignment, initial amplification endpoint, complete final-PCR recipe/program and AMPure ratio. Known input/output identities and reported routes remain supported; do not replace missing values with defaults.

Nonblocking optional-calibration acquisition retained in calibration_internal_details: if independently reconstructing the manual/reference calibration, acquire the applicable primer/reference data and SAFA DOI 10.1261/rna.7214405 plus manual-normalization DOI 10.1073/pnas.1006897107 and calibration code/anchors. Their unavailable internals do not block reporting the source’s manual measurement boundary, criterion and fixed alpha=0.25, and no new calibration experiment is required for every library.

Source-internal detail gap already retained as acquire_nuclei_dependency and footprinting_recipe_details: Miranda et al. 2010 is absent from the packet. Acquire DOI 10.1002/0471142727.mb2117s89 (PMID 20069538), its applicable support protocols, and the article supplement to inspect IMR90 isolation, reaction loading/buffer/SAM quantities and stopping/extraction. The explicit cells→nuclei→treated nuclei→DNA boundaries remain supportable for this frozen general scope; an executable recipe cannot be supplied.

Applicable supplementary evidence is absent from the packet, as acquire_applicable_supplement records. Retrieve/register the supplement via DOI 10.1101/gr.143008.112, especially S1/S1A, S8 and tool instructions. These are needed to refine lower-dose outcomes, off-target quantitation and exact tool use. The direct main-text fixed treatment, signal caveat and source-described rules suffice for the qualified general boundary; no supplementary results are accepted by implication.

Library and processing internals remain unavailable as the candidate records. Acquire Lister 2009 DOI 10.1038/nature08514; Kelly 2010 DOI 10.1016/j.molcel.2010.08.026; Berman 2012 DOI 10.1038/ng.969; Liu 2012 DOI 10.1186/gb-2012-13-7-r61, with applicable methods/supplements and contemporaneous publication-associated tool instructions. Establish actual adoption before transferring recipes, settings, end chemistry or numerical behavior. Known library inputs/order/products and directly stated analysis rules make this nonblocking for the general implementation; mask/eligibility ordering, exact invocations and historical numerical reproduction remain unresolved.

The selected optional locus branch remains a reported conversion→PCR→TA-cloning→sequencing boundary. As targeted_recipe_details records, exact primers, conversion resource/program, PCR/cloning settings and targeted sequencer are unavailable. Retrieve an archived source-authored locus primer/procedure listing if those internals are needed; do not assign whole-genome Zymo/Hi-seq resources by default. This is a noncritical recipe gap for the declared general boundary.

The packet lacks the separate Supplementary Figures 1–13 document and Supplementary Tables 1–2. Acquire and register NIHMS59406-supplement-1.doc, NIHMS59406-supplement-Supp_Table_1.xlsx and NIHMS59406-supplement-Supp_Table_2.xlsx from the article supplementary bundle, then inspect applicable library-size/low-complexity, saturation, conversion and genomic-context legends/tables. This is outstanding source acquisition, not evidence of a missing production operation: the main Methods and readable Note 1 already support the candidate’s qualified general route and its attributed observations. Do not add table-specific settings or performance contracts until these are inspected.
